evidence_required: Definitions of FWS, TCS and approach, and the hot-afternoon mechanism.

marking.criterion: FWS is the facility primary water loop; TCS is the clean, filtered secondary loop through the cold plates
Approach is TCS supply minus FWS supply at the CDU heat exchanger
Hot afternoon raises FWS supply, TCS supply follows at roughly constant approach, cold plates warm, and a GPU with little margin enters thermal slowdown

title: FWS, TCS and approach temperature
